owners.agent: Adds roles as 'new', archives 'new' roles (with a reason), revives roles it archived as expired, and writes 'notes'.
owners.user: Sets applied, in_process and rejected, archives anything, and owns 'my_notes' and 'hiring_manager'. The agent never changes these.

meta.human_contact_rule: true once a role reached in_process; false when it was rejected without reaching in_process; otherwise null.
